question_set.question: Use highlight_path in order to know Which traffic entry to financial product path shows the most significant conversion volume?

answer.value: The path from Alipay/WeChat Entry to Payment demonstrates the most significant conversion volume with 12000 transactions, representing 47.1% of all traffic from Alipay/WeChat Entry and being the largest single flow in the entire sankey diagram

key_insights: Alipay/WeChat Entry to Payment is the largest single flow at 12000
This path represents nearly half of Alipay/WeChat Entry traffic
Payment receives the highest total inflow among all financial products
